+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_summary;
+
+use Drupal\text\TextSummary;
+
+/**
+ * Builds teaser summaries the same way the summary-or-trimmed display does.
+ */
+class Teaser {
+
+  public function __construct(
+    protected readonly TextSummary $textSummary,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the summary Drupal generates for HTML at the given size.
+   *
+   * No text format is used, so format-dependent behavior (line break
+   * conversion and HTML normalization) does not apply.
+   *
+   * @param string $html
+   *   The HTML to summarize.
+   * @param int $size
+   *   The desired character length of the summary.
+   *
+   * @return string
+   *   The generated summary.
+   */
+  public function summarize(string $html, int $size): string {
+    return (string) $this->textSummary->generate($html, NULL, $size);
+  }
+
+}

+use Drupal\Core\Form\FormStateInterface;

+++ b/web/modules/custom/bench_titles/src/BenchTitlesBuilder.php
@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+<?php
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_titles;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityRepositoryInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Language\LanguageInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Link;
+
+/**
+ * Builds a list of links to nodes.
+ */
+class BenchTitlesBuilder {
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a BenchTitlesBuilder object.
+   */
+  public function __construct(
+    protected EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager,
+    protected EntityRepositoryInterface $entityRepository,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Builds a renderable list of links to the given nodes.
+   *
+   * @param int[] $nids
+   *   Node IDs, rendered in the order given.
+   * @param string $title
+   *   Heading of the list.
+   *
+   * @return array
+   *   A render array.
+   */
+  public function build(array $nids, $title = ''): array {
+    $nodes = $this->entityTypeManager->getStorage('node')->loadMultiple($nids);
+
+    $items = [];
+    $tags = [];
+    foreach ($nids as $nid) {
+      if (!isset($nodes[$nid])) {
+        continue;
+      }
+      // Use the translation for the current content language.
+      $node = $this->entityRepository->getTranslationFromContext($nodes[$nid]);
+      $items[] = Link::fromTextAndUrl($node->label(), $node->toUrl())->toRenderable();
+      $tags[] = 'node:' . $nid;
+    }
+
+    return [
+      '#theme' => 'item_list',
+      '#title' => $title,
+      '#items' => $items,
+      '#cache' => [
+        'tags' => $tags,
+        'contexts' => ['languages:' . LanguageInterface::TYPE_CONTENT],
+      ],
+    ];
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+/**
+ * @file
+ * Attaches the Inter typography library and preloads its font file.
+ */
+
+use Drupal\Core\Url;
+
+/**
+ * Implements hook_page_attachments().
+ */
+function bench_fonts_page_attachments(array &$attachments) {
+  // Only front-end pages; admin routes keep their own typography.
+  if (\Drupal::service('router.admin_context')->isAdminRoute()) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  $attachments['#attached']['library'][] = 'bench_fonts/typography';
+
+  // Font preloads need crossorigin even for same-origin files, or the browser
+  // downloads the font twice.
+  $font_path = \Drupal::service('extension.list.module')->getPath('bench_fonts') . '/fonts/inter.woff2';
+  $attachments['#attached']['html_head_link'][] = [
+    [
+      'rel' => 'preload',
+      'href' => Url::fromUri('base:' . $font_path)->toString(),
+      'as' => 'font',
+      'type' => 'font/woff2',
+      'crossorigin' => 'anonymous',
+    ],
+    TRUE,
+  ];
+}

+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_latest\Plugin\Block;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Block\Attribute\Block;
+use Drupal\Core\Block\BlockBase;
+use Drupal\Core\StringTranslation\TranslatableMarkup;
+
+/**
+ * Lists the titles of the three newest published articles.
+ */
+#[Block(
+  id: 'bench_latest_articles',
+  admin_label: new TranslatableMarkup('Latest articles'),
+)]
+class LatestArticlesBlock extends BlockBase {
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function build(): array {
+    $storage = \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('node');
+    $query = $storage->getQuery()
+      ->accessCheck(TRUE)
+      ->condition('type', 'article')
+      ->condition('status', 1)
+      ->sort('created', 'DESC')
+      ->sort('nid', 'DESC')
+      ->range(0, 3);
+    $nids = $query->execute();
+
+    $items = [];
+    foreach ($storage->loadMultiple($nids) as $node) {
+      $items[] = ['#markup' => $node->label()];
+    }
+
+    return [
+      '#theme' => 'item_list',
+      '#items' => $items,
+      '#cache' => [
+        // Article saves, updates and deletes invalidate this list tag only;
+        // other content types do not.
+        'tags' => ['node_list:article'],
+        'contexts' => ['user.node_grants:view'],
+      ],
+    ];
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_latest\Plugin\Block;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Block\Attribute\Block;
+use Drupal\Core\Block\BlockBase;
+use Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheableMetadata;
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Plugin\ContainerFactoryPluginInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\StringTranslation\TranslatableMarkup;
+use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Lists the titles of the three newest published articles.
+ */
+#[Block(
+  id: 'bench_latest_articles',
+  admin_label: new TranslatableMarkup('Latest articles'),
+  category: new TranslatableMarkup('Lists (Views)'),
+)]
+class LatestArticlesBlock extends BlockBase implements ContainerFactoryPluginInterface {
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a LatestArticlesBlock.
+   */
+  public function __construct(
+    array $configuration,
+    $plugin_id,
+    $plugin_definition,
+    protected readonly EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeMgr,
+  ) {
+    parent::__construct($configuration, $plugin_id, $plugin_definition);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public static function create(ContainerInterface $container, array $configuration, $plugin_id, $plugin_definition): static {
+    return new static(
+      $configuration,
+      $plugin_id,
+      $plugin_definition,
+      $container->get(EntityTypeManagerInterface::class),
+    );
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function build(): array {
+    $storage = $this->entityTypeMgr->getStorage('node');
+    $ids = $storage->getQuery()
+      ->accessCheck(TRUE)
+      ->condition('type', 'article')
+      ->condition('status', 1)
+      ->sort('created', 'DESC')
+      // Nodes saved in the same second share a created time; the higher ID is
+      // the newer node, so use it to break the tie.
+      ->sort('nid', 'DESC')
+      ->range(0, 3)
+      ->execute();
+
+    $build = ['#theme' => 'item_list', '#items' => []];
+    $cacheability = new CacheableMetadata();
+    // Any article being saved, published or deleted invalidates this tag. Other
+    // content types do not, so their changes leave this block cached.
+    $cacheability->addCacheTags(['node_list:article']);
+    // The query result depends on what the user is allowed to see.
+    $cacheability->addCacheContexts(['user.permissions']);
+
+    foreach ($storage->loadMultiple($ids) as $node) {
+      $build['#items'][] = $node->label();
+      // Adds node:<id>, so editing a title refreshes the list.
+      $cacheability->addCacheableDependency($node);
+    }
+
+    $cacheability->applyTo($build);
+    return $build;
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_lazy;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface;
+use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Counts nodes, loading the entity type manager only when needed.
+ */
+class Counter {
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a Counter object.
+   *
+   * @param \Closure $entityTypeManagerFactory
+   *   A closure that returns the entity type manager. It is only called when
+   *   the entity type manager is first needed.
+   */
+  public function __construct(
+    protected readonly \Closure $entityTypeManagerFactory,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Creates a Counter that resolves the entity type manager lazily.
+   *
+   * @param \Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerInterface $container
+   *   The service container.
+   *
+   * @return static
+   */
+  public static function create(ContainerInterface $container): static {
+    return new static(
+      fn() => $container->get('entity_type.manager'),
+    );
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the number of nodes.
+   *
+   * @return int
+   *   The number of nodes.
+   */
+  public function nodeCount(): int {
+    $factory = $this->entityTypeManagerFactory;
+    /** @var \Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface $entity_type_manager */
+    $entity_type_manager = $factory();
+    assert($entity_type_manager instanceof EntityTypeManagerInterface);
+
+    return (int) $entity_type_manager->getStorage('node')
+      ->getQuery()
+      ->accessCheck(FALSE)
+      ->count()
+      ->execute();
+  }
+
+}

+<?php

+/**
+ * Builds a render array with a secret section that can be hidden.
+ */
+class Builder {
+
+  /**
+   * Builds the render array.
+   *
+   * The 'secret' child is always present in the array, but when $showSecret
+   * is FALSE it is flagged as printed so it renders as an empty string. Its
+   * '#access' setting is left untouched.
+   *
+   * @param bool $showSecret
+   *   Whether the secret section should be output.
+   *
+   * @return array
+   *   The render array.
+   */
+  public function build(bool $showSecret): array {
+    $build = [
+      'intro' => ['#markup' => 'Welcome.'],
+      'secret' => ['#markup' => 'Staff only.'],
+      'outro' => ['#markup' => 'Goodbye.'],
+    ];
+
+    if (!$showSecret) {
+      $build['secret']['#printed'] = TRUE;
+    }
+
+    return $build;
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_feedback;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Form\FormStateInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\State\StateInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Saves submitted feedback messages to site state.
+ *
+ * Reusable by other forms: pass the form and its state to ::record().
+ */
+class FeedbackRecorder {
+
+  /**
+   * The state key holding the last recorded message.
+   */
+  public const STATE_KEY = 'bench_feedback.last';
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a FeedbackRecorder object.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\State\StateInterface $state
+   *   The state service.
+   */
+  public function __construct(protected StateInterface $state) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Records the submitted message.
+   *
+   * @param array $form
+   *   The form array.
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Form\FormStateInterface $form_state
+   *   The form state containing the submitted 'message' value.
+   */
+  public function record(array &$form, FormStateInterface $form_state): void {
+    $this->state->set(self::STATE_KEY, $form_state->getValue('message'));
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_catalog;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheBackendInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\PreWarm\PreWarmableInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Provides the catalog items, cached in the default cache bin.
+ */
+class Catalog implements PreWarmableInterface {
+
+  /**
+   * The cache item ID for the catalog items.
+   */
+  const CID = 'bench_catalog:items';
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a Catalog object.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheBackendInterface $cache
+   *   The default cache bin.
+   */
+  public function __construct(
+    protected CacheBackendInterface $cache,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the catalog items.
+   *
+   * @return string[]
+   *   The catalog items.
+   */
+  public function getItems(): array {
+    if ($cached = $this->cache->get(self::CID)) {
+      return $cached->data;
+    }
+    $items = $this->buildItems();
+    $this->cache->set(self::CID, $items);
+    return $items;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function preWarm(): void {
+    $this->getItems();
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Builds the catalog items. This is the expensive part being cached.
+   *
+   * @return string[]
+   *   The catalog items.
+   */
+  protected function buildItems(): array {
+    return ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma'];
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_apimeta\EventSubscriber;
+
+use Drupal\jsonapi\Events\CollectResourceObjectMetaEvent;
+use Symfony\Component\EventDispatcher\EventSubscriberInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Adds the title length of article nodes to their JSON:API resource meta.
+ */
+class ArticleTitleLengthMetaSubscriber implements EventSubscriberInterface {
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public static function getSubscribedEvents(): array {
+    return [
+      CollectResourceObjectMetaEvent::class => 'addTitleLength',
+    ];
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Sets the 'bench_title_length' meta value on article resource objects.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\jsonapi\Events\CollectResourceObjectMetaEvent $event
+   *   The event.
+   */
+  public function addTitleLength(CollectResourceObjectMetaEvent $event): void {
+    $resource_object = $event->getResourceObject();
+    if ($resource_object->getTypeName() !== 'node--article' || !$resource_object->hasField('title')) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    $title = (string) $resource_object->getField('title')->value;
+    $event->setMetaValue('bench_title_length', mb_strlen($title));
+    // The title comes from the resource object, so its cacheability (the
+    // node's cache tags) must bubble up to the response.
+    $event->addCacheableDependency($resource_object);
+  }
+
+}

+<?php

+namespace Drupal\bench_grants;

+use Drupal\node\NodeAccessRebuild;

+/**
+ * Manages the pending content access (node grant) rebuild.
+ */
+class Maintenance {
+
+  public function __construct(
+    protected readonly NodeAccessRebuild $nodeAccessRebuild,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Marks the node access permissions as needing a rebuild.
+   *
+   * The status report shows a warning until the rebuild is run.
+   */
+  public function flag(): void {
+    $this->nodeAccessRebuild->setNeedsRebuild(TRUE);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Whether a node access rebuild is pending.
+   */
+  public function isFlagged(): bool {
+    return $this->nodeAccessRebuild->needsRebuild();
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Rebuilds the node access permissions immediately, without a batch.
+   *
+   * Clears the pending flag, which removes the status report warning.
+   */
+  public function rebuildNow(): void {
+    $this->nodeAccessRebuild->rebuild(FALSE);
+  }
+
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_batch;
+
+use Drupal\Core\State\StateInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Builds a three-step batch job that increments a state counter.
+ */
+class Counter {
+
+  /**
+   * The number of steps in the job.
+   */
+  public const STEPS = 3;
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a Counter object.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\State\StateInterface $state
+   *   The state service.
+   */
+  public function __construct(
+    protected StateInterface $state,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the batch job definition for use with batch_set().
+   *
+   * @return array
+   *   A batch definition array.
+   */
+  public function buildBatch(): array {
+    $operations = [];
+    for ($i = 1; $i <= self::STEPS; $i++) {
+      $operations[] = [[self::class, 'processStep'], [$i]];
+    }
+
+    return [
+      'title' => t('Counting'),
+      'init_message' => t('Starting the counter job.'),
+      'progress_message' => t('Completed @current of @total steps.'),
+      'error_message' => t('The counter job has encountered an error.'),

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_batch;
+
+use Drupal\Core\State\StateInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\StringTranslation\TranslatableMarkup;
+
+/**
+ * Builds and runs a three-step batch job that counts into site state.
+ */
+final class BatchCounter {
+
+  /**
+   * Number of batch steps.
+   */
+  public const STEPS = 3;
+
+  public function __construct(
+    private readonly StateInterface $state,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the batch job definition.
+   *
+   * @return array
+   *   A batch definition ready for batch_set().
+   */
+  public function buildBatch(): array {
+    $operations = [];
+    for ($i = 0; $i < self::STEPS; $i++) {
+      $operations[] = ['bench_batch.counter:step', []];
+    }
+
+    return [
+      'title' => new TranslatableMarkup('Counting steps'),
+      'operations' => $operations,
+      'finished' => 'bench_batch.counter:finished',
+    ];
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Batch operation: adds 1 to the bench_batch.count state value.
+   *
+   * @param array $context
+   *   The batch context.
+   */
+  public function step(array &$context): void {
+    $this->state->set('bench_batch.count', (int) $this->state->get('bench_batch.count', 0) + 1);
+    $context['message'] = new TranslatableMarkup('Counted a step.');
+    $context['finished'] = 1;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Batch finished callback: marks the job as done.
+   *
+   * @param bool $success
+   *   Whether all operations completed without error.
+   * @param array $results
+   *   The batch results.
+   * @param array $operations
+   *   Operations that remained unprocessed on error.
+   */
+  public function finished(bool $success, array $results, array $operations): void {
+    if ($success) {
+      $this->state->set('bench_batch.done', TRUE);
+    }
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_where\Plugin\Block;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Block\Attribute\Block;
+use Drupal\Core\Block\BlockBase;
+use Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheOptionalInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Path\CurrentPathStack;
+use Drupal\Core\Plugin\ContainerFactoryPluginInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\StringTranslation\TranslatableMarkup;
+use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Provides a block that shows the current path.
+ *
+ * The block is cheap to build, so it implements CacheOptionalInterface to
+ * skip the dynamic render cache. Its url.path cache context still makes the
+ * page that shows it vary per path, and the page remains cacheable.
+ */
+#[Block(
+  id: "bench_where_path",
+  admin_label: new TranslatableMarkup("You are here"),
+)]
+class BenchWherePathBlock extends BlockBase implements ContainerFactoryPluginInterface, CacheOptionalInterface {
+
+  /**
+   * The current path service.
+   *
+   * @var \Drupal\Core\Path\CurrentPathStack
+   */
+  protected CurrentPathStack $currentPath;
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public static function create(ContainerInterface $container, array $configuration, $plugin_id, $plugin_definition): static {
+    $instance = new static($configuration, $plugin_id, $plugin_definition);
+    $instance->currentPath = $container->get('path.current');
+    return $instance;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function build(): array {
+    return [
+      '#markup' => $this->t('You are at: @path', ['@path' => $this->currentPath->getPath()]),
+    ];
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function getCacheContexts(): array {
+    return ['url.path'];
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_stats;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Security\TrustedCallbackInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\StringTranslation\TranslatableMarkup;
+
+/**
+ * Builds the published content count for the block's lazy builder.
+ */
+class ContentCountBuilder implements TrustedCallbackInterface {
+
+  public function __construct(
+    protected readonly EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypes,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Counts all published nodes, regardless of the current user.
+   */
+  public function build(): array {
+    $count = $this->entityTypes->getStorage('node')->getQuery()
+      ->accessCheck(FALSE)
+      ->condition('status', 1)
+      ->count()
+      ->execute();
+
+    return [
+      '#markup' => new TranslatableMarkup('Published content: @count', ['@count' => $count]),
+      // Any node save or delete changes the count. This tag stays on the
+      // placeholder, so it does not invalidate the pages that show the block.
+      '#cache' => ['tags' => ['node_list']],
+    ];
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public static function trustedCallbacks(): array {
+    return ['build'];
+  }
+
+}

+/**
+ * Reports the node access grants an account receives, as core computes them.

+
+  public function __construct(
+    protected readonly NodeGrantsHelper $grantsHelper,
+    protected readonly NodeGrantDatabaseStorageInterface $grantStorage,

+  /**
+   * Returns the node access grants for an account and operation.

+<?php
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_decor;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Logger\LoggerChannelFactoryInterface;
+use Drupal\ban\BanIpManagerInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Wraps the Ban IP manager and logs every IP ban.
+ */
+class BanIpManagerLogger implements BanIpManagerInterface {
+
+  /**
+   * The decorated Ban IP manager.
+   *
+   * @var \Drupal\ban\BanIpManagerInterface
+   */
+  protected $inner;
+
+  /**
+   * The logger channel.
+   *
+   * @var \Psr\Log\LoggerInterface
+   */
+  protected $logger;
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a BanIpManagerLogger object.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\ban\BanIpManagerInterface $inner
+   *   The decorated Ban IP manager.
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Logger\LoggerChannelFactoryInterface $logger_factory
+   *   The logger channel factory.
+   */
+  public function __construct(BanIpManagerInterface $inner, LoggerChannelFactoryInterface $logger_factory) {
+    $this->inner = $inner;
+    $this->logger = $logger_factory->get('bench_decor');
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function isBanned($ip) {
+    return $this->inner->isBanned($ip);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function findAll() {
+    return $this->inner->findAll();
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function banIp($ip) {
+    $this->logger->notice('Banned IP address @ip.', ['@ip' => $ip]);
+    return $this->inner->banIp($ip);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function unbanIp($id) {
+    return $this->inner->unbanIp($id);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function findById($ban_id) {
+    return $this->inner->findById($ban_id);
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_decor;
+
+use Drupal\Core\DependencyInjection\ContainerBuilder;
+use Drupal\Core\DependencyInjection\ServiceModifierInterface;
+use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Reference;
+
+/**
+ * Decorates the Ban IP manager when the Ban module is enabled.
+ *
+ * Ban is optional, so the decoration is added only if its service exists.
+ */
+class BenchDecorServiceProvider implements ServiceModifierInterface {
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function alter(ContainerBuilder $container) {
+    if (!$container->hasDefinition('ban.ip_manager')) {
+      return;
+    }
+    $container->register('bench_decor.ban_logger', BanIpManagerLogger::class)
+      ->setDecoratedService('ban.ip_manager')
+      ->addArgument(new Reference('bench_decor.ban_logger.inner'))
+      ->addArgument(new Reference('logger.factory'));
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_members\Access;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Access\AccessResult;
+use Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheableDependencyInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Session\AccountInterface;
+use Drupal\user\UserInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Decides whether an account may see member-only content.
+ */
+class MemberAccess {
+
+  /**
+   * Checks access to member-only content for the given account.
+   *
+   * Blocked accounts are forbidden. Members are allowed. Everyone else gets a
+   * neutral result so other access rules can still decide.
+   */
+  public function check(AccountInterface $account): AccessResult {
+    if ($account instanceof UserInterface && $account->isBlocked()) {
+      $result = AccessResult::forbidden('Blocked accounts cannot see member content.');
+    }
+    elseif (in_array('member', $account->getRoles(), TRUE)) {
+      $result = AccessResult::allowed();
+    }
+    else {
+      $result = AccessResult::neutral('Only members can see this content.');
+    }
+
+    // The outcome depends on roles, so cache per role set. The user entity
+    // dependency covers the blocked status.
+    $result->addCacheContexts(['user.roles']);
+    if ($account instanceof CacheableDependencyInterface) {
+      $result->addCacheableDependency($account);
+    }
+
+    return $result;
+  }
+
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_members\Access;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Access\AccessResult;
+use Drupal\Core\Access\AccessResultInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Session\AccountInterface;
+use Drupal\user\UserInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Decides whether an account may see members-only content.
+ */
+class MemberAccess {
+
+  /**
+   * The role that grants access to members-only content.
+   */
+  public const MEMBER_ROLE = 'member';
+
+  /**
+   * Checks an account's access to members-only content.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Session\AccountInterface $account
+   *   The account to check.
+   *
+   * @return \Drupal\Core\Access\AccessResultInterface
+   *   Forbidden for blocked accounts, allowed for members, and neutral for
+   *   everyone else so other access rules can still decide.
+   */
+  public function check(AccountInterface $account): AccessResultInterface {
+    // Blocked status is a user property, not a role, so the result must also
+    // vary per user. cachePerUser() adds the 'user' cache context, which
+    // covers 'user.roles' too. Otherwise a blocked account could reuse a
+    // cached result from an unblocked account with the same roles.
+    if ($account instanceof UserInterface && $account->isBlocked()) {
+      return AccessResult::forbidden('Blocked accounts cannot see member content.')
+        ->cachePerUser();
+    }
+
+    if (in_array(self::MEMBER_ROLE, $account->getRoles(), TRUE)) {
+      return AccessResult::allowed()->cachePerUser();
+    }
+
+    return AccessResult::neutral('Only members can see this content.')
+      ->cachePerUser();
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_bulk;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Performs bulk node operations synchronously, without the Batch API.
+ */
+final class BulkUpdater {
+
+  /**
+   * Number of nodes loaded and saved at a time.
+   */
+  private const CHUNK_SIZE = 100;
+
+  public function __construct(
+    private readonly EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Unpublishes every node of the given content type in a single request.
+   *
+   * Each node is saved through the entity API so that node access grants,
+   * cache tags, and hooks are updated. Nodes are loaded in chunks and the
+   * entity cache is reset between chunks to keep memory bounded.
+   *
+   * @param string $type
+   *   The machine name of the content type.
+   *
+   * @return int
+   *   The number of nodes that were unpublished.
+   */
+  public function unpublishType(string $type): int {
+    $storage = $this->entityTypeManager->getStorage('node');
+
+    $nids = $storage->getQuery()
+      ->accessCheck(FALSE)
+      ->condition('type', $type)
+      ->sort('nid')
+      ->execute();
+
+    $count = 0;
+    foreach (array_chunk($nids, self::CHUNK_SIZE) as $chunk) {
+      foreach ($storage->loadMultiple($chunk) as $node) {
+        /** @var \Drupal\node\NodeInterface $node */
+        $changed = FALSE;
+        foreach ($node->getTranslationLanguages() as $language) {
+          $translation = $node->getTranslation($language->getId());
+          if ($translation->isPublished()) {
+            $translation->setUnpublished();
+            $changed = TRUE;
+          }
+        }
+        if ($changed) {
+          $node->save();
+          $count++;
+        }
+      }
+      $storage->resetCache($chunk);
+    }
+
+    return $count;
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_onceb;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Batch\BatchBuilder;
+
+/**
+ * Queues a search index rebuild into the current request's batch.
+ */
+class Queuer {
+
+  /**
+   * The batch set ID used for the index rebuild.
+   */
+  public const SET_ID = 'bench_onceb_rebuild';
+
+  /**
+   * Adds the index rebuild job to the current batch, once per request.
+   */
+  public function queue(): void {
+    if (BatchBuilder::isSetIdRegistered(self::SET_ID)) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    $batch_builder = (new BatchBuilder())
+      ->registerSetId(self::SET_ID)
+      ->setTitle(t('Rebuild index'))
+      ->addOperation([RebuildIndex::class, 'process']);
+
+    batch_set($batch_builder->toArray());
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_quote\Controller;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Controller\ControllerBase;
+use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
+
+/**
+ * Serves the quote page and the bare quote fragment.
+ */
+final class QuoteController extends ControllerBase {
+
+  /**
+   * The quote returned by the fragment route.
+   */
+  private const QUOTE = 'Quote: Simplicity is a prerequisite for reliability.';
+
+  /**
+   * Builds the quote page with a box and a button that loads the next quote.
+   */
+  public function page(): array {
+    return [
+      'box' => [
+        '#type' => 'html_tag',
+        '#tag' => 'div',
+        '#attributes' => ['id' => 'bench-quote'],
+      ],
+      'button' => [
+        '#type' => 'html_tag',
+        '#tag' => 'button',
+        '#attributes' => ['type' => 'button', 'id' => 'bench-quote-next'],
+        '#value' => 'Next quote',
+      ],
+      'script' => [
+        '#type' => 'html_tag',
+        '#tag' => 'script',
+        '#value' => "(function () {\n"
+          . "  var box = document.getElementById('bench-quote');\n"
+          . "  document.getElementById('bench-quote-next').addEventListener('click', function () {\n"
+          . "    fetch('/bench-quote/next', { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store' })\n"
+          . "      .then(function (response) { return response.text(); })\n"
+          . "      .then(function (text) { box.textContent = text; });\n"
+          . "  });\n"
+          . "})();",
+      ],
+    ];
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Returns only the quote, bypassing the theme and page regions.
+   */
+  public function next(): Response {
+    return new Response(self::QUOTE, 200, [
+      'Content-Type' => 'text/plain; charset=UTF-8',
+      'Cache-Control' => 'no-store, private',
+    ]);
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+/**
+ * @file
+ * Logs node title changes to site state.
+ */
+
+use Drupal\node\NodeInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Implements hook_ENTITY_TYPE_presave() for node.
+ */
+function bench_retitle_node_presave(NodeInterface $node) {
+  if ($node->isNew() || !isset($node->original)) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  $old_title = $node->original->getTitle();
+  $new_title = $node->getTitle();
+  if ($old_title === $new_title) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  $state = \Drupal::state();
+  $log = $state->get('bench_retitle.log', []);
+  $log[] = $old_title . ' -> ' . $new_title;
+  $state->set('bench_retitle.log', $log);
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_signup\Form;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Form\FormBase;
+use Drupal\Core\Form\FormStateInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Signup form shown at /signup.
+ */
+final class SignupForm extends FormBase {
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function getFormId(): string {
+    return 'bench_signup_form';
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function buildForm(array $form, FormStateInterface $form_state): array {
+    // The form is the same for every visitor, so let the render cache keep it
+    // for up to one hour. Render caching needs cache keys; the max-age caps
+    // how long the cached copy is served.
+    $form['#cache']['keys'] = ['bench_signup_form'];
+    $form['#cache']['max-age'] = 3600;
+
+    $form['email'] = [
+      '#type' => 'email',
+      '#title' => $this->t('Email'),
+      '#required' => TRUE,
+    ];
+    $form['actions'] = [
+      '#type' => 'actions',
+      'submit' => [
+        '#type' => 'submit',
+        '#value' => $this->t('Sign up'),
+      ],
+    ];
+
+    return $form;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function submitForm(array &$form, FormStateInterface $form_state): void {
+    $this->messenger()->addStatus($this->t('Thanks for signing up.'));
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_editorinfo;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Looks up the editor configured for a text format.
+ */
+class EditorLookup {
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs an EditorLookup object.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager
+   *   The entity type manager.
+   */
+  public function __construct(
+    protected EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the ID of the editor configured for a text format.
+   *
+   * @param string $format_id
+   *   The text format ID, for example "basic_html".
+   *
+   * @return string|null
+   *   The editor plugin ID (for example "ckeditor5"), or NULL if the text
+   *   format has no editor configured.
+   */
+  public function editorFor(string $format_id): ?string {
+    $editor = $this->entityTypeManager->getStorage('editor')->load($format_id);
+    if ($editor === NULL) {
+      return NULL;
+    }
+    $editor_id = $editor->getEditor();
+    return $editor_id !== '' ? $editor_id : NULL;
+  }
+
+}

+/**

+
+use Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheableMetadata;

+
+/**

+function bench_ops_entity_operation(EntityInterface $entity, CacheableMetadata $cacheability) {

+  if ($entity->getEntityTypeId() !== 'node') {
+    return $operations;

+      'weight' => 50,

+    return new static(
+      $configuration,
+      $plugin_id,
+      $plugin_definition,
+      $container->get('request_stack'),
+    );
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function build(): array {
+    if (!in_array($this->getStatusCode(), self::HINT_STATUS_CODES, TRUE)) {
+      return [];
+    }
+    return ['#markup' => $this->t('Try the search page.')];
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   *
+   * The output depends only on the exception status code (0, 403 or 404), so
+   * the block is cached once per kind of page rather than once per URL.
+   */
+  public function getCacheContexts(): array {
+    return Cache::mergeContexts(parent::getCacheContexts(), ['exception_status_code']);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the HTTP status code of the current exception, or 0 if none.
+   */
+  private function getStatusCode(): int {
+    $exception = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest()?->attributes->get('exception');
+    return $exception instanceof HttpExceptionInterface ? $exception->getStatusCode() : 0;
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+/**
+ * @file
+ * Restricts JSON:API filtering of user collections to active accounts.
+ */
+
+use Drupal\Core\Access\AccessResult;
+use Drupal\Core\Access\AccessResultInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Field\FieldDefinitionInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Session\AccountInterface;
+use Drupal\jsonapi\JsonApiFilter;
+
+/**
+ * Implements hook_jsonapi_ENTITY_TYPE_filter_access() for user entities.
+ *
+ * Users with 'access user profiles' may filter user collections, but only the
+ * active (not blocked) subset. Blocked accounts are never filterable for them.
+ */
+function bench_apifilter_jsonapi_user_filter_access(EntityTypeInterface $entity_type, AccountInterface $account): array {
+  return [
+    JsonApiFilter::AMONG_ENABLED => AccessResult::allowedIfHasPermission($account, 'access user profiles'),
+  ];
+}
+
+/**
+ * Implements hook_jsonapi_entity_field_filter_access().
+ *
+ * Core hides the user 'status' field from non-admins, which also blocks
+ * filtering on it. Allow filtering on it for 'access user profiles' users.
+ * This only grants filter access; the status attribute itself stays hidden.
+ */
+function bench_apifilter_jsonapi_entity_field_filter_access(FieldDefinitionInterface $field_definition, AccountInterface $account): AccessResultInterface {
+  if ($field_definition->getTargetEntityTypeId() === 'user' && $field_definition->getName() === 'status') {
+    return AccessResult::allowedIfHasPermission($account, 'access user profiles');
+  }
+  return AccessResult::neutral();
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_apifilter\Hook;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Database\Connection;
+use Drupal\Core\Database\Query\SelectInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Hook\Attribute\Hook;
+use Drupal\Core\Session\AccountInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Database hook implementations for bench_apifilter.
+ */
+class BenchApifilterHooks {
+
+  public function __construct(
+    protected readonly Connection $database,
+    protected readonly AccountInterface $currentUser,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Implements hook_query_TAG_alter() for the 'user_access' query tag.
+   *
+   * Entity queries for users (including JSON:API collections) carry this tag
+   * when access checked. Accounts with 'access user profiles' only see active
+   * (not blocked) users. Accounts without it see no users.
+   */
+  #[Hook('query_user_access_alter')]
+  public function queryUserAccessAlter(SelectInterface $query): void {
+    $account = $query->getMetaData('account') ?? $this->currentUser;
+
+    // Administrators keep the full list, including blocked accounts, so the
+    // People administration page keeps working.
+    if ($account->hasPermission('administer users')) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!$account->hasPermission('access user profiles')) {
+      $query->where('1 = 0');
+      return;
+    }
+
+    $active_uids = $this->database->select('users_field_data', 'ufd')
+      ->fields('ufd', ['uid'])
+      ->condition('ufd.status', 1);
+    $query->condition('base_table.uid', $active_uids, 'IN');
+  }
+
+}

+/**
+ * Finds the nodes that reference a file.
+ *
+ * The file_usage table only records the default revision of an entity, so
+ * this scans the field tables directly. That includes the revision tables,
+ * which hold every revision, so older and draft revisions are found too.
+ */
+class FileUsageFinder {
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a FileUsageFinder object.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager
+   *   The entity type manager.
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityFieldManagerInterface $entityFieldManager

+    protected EntityFieldManagerInterface $entityFieldManager,

+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Returns the sorted IDs of the nodes that use a file.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\file\FileInterface|int|string $file
+   *   The file entity, or its ID.
+   *
+   * @return int[]

+   */
+  public function nodeIds(FileInterface|int|string $file): array {
+    $fid = $file instanceof FileInterface ? (int) $file->id() : (int) $file;
+    $storage = $this->entityTypeManager->getStorage('node');
+    $table_mapping = $storage->getTableMapping();
+
+    $nids = [];
+    foreach (['file', 'image'] as $field_type) {
+      $field_map = $this->entityFieldManager->getFieldMapByFieldType($field_type);
+      foreach (array_keys($field_map['node'] ?? []) as $field_name) {
+        $column = $table_mapping->getColumnNames($field_name)['target_id'] ?? NULL;
+        if ($column === NULL) {
+          continue;
+        }
+        // Covers the current table and the revision table(s) for the field.
+        foreach ($table_mapping->getAllFieldTableNames($field_name) as $table) {
+          $query = $this->database->select($table, 't')
+            ->fields('t', ['entity_id'])
+            ->condition("t.$column", $fid);
+          $nids += array_fill_keys($query->distinct()->execute()->fetchCol(), TRUE);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+
+    $nids = array_map('intval', array_keys($nids));
+    sort($nids);
+    return $nids;
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_notice\Plugin\Block;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Block\Attribute\Block;
+use Drupal\Core\Block\BlockBase;
+use Drupal\big_pipe\Render\Placeholder\BigPipeStrategy;
+use Drupal\Core\Security\TrustedCallbackInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\StringTranslation\TranslatableMarkup;
+
+/**
+ * Provides a maintenance notice block.
+ *
+ * The notice is rendered through a lazy builder so it is always filled in
+ * outside the cached page. BigPipe is denied for it, so it is never streamed
+ * in late.
+ */
+#[Block(
+  id: "bench_notice_banner",
+  admin_label: new TranslatableMarkup("Maintenance notice"),
+)]

+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function build() {
+    return [
+      '#lazy_builder' => [static::class . '::buildNotice', []],
+      '#create_placeholder' => TRUE,
+      '#placeholder_strategy_denylist' => [BigPipeStrategy::class => TRUE],
+      '#cache' => ['max-age' => 0],
+    ];
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Builds the notice text.
+   *
+   * @return array
+   *   A render array containing the notice.
+   */
+  public static function buildNotice(): array {
+    return [
+      '#markup' => (string) new TranslatableMarkup('Scheduled maintenance on Sunday.'),
+      '#cache' => ['max-age' => 0],
+    ];
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public static function trustedCallbacks() {
+    return ['buildNotice'];
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_memo;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheBackendInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Computes squares, remembering results for the current request only.
+ */
+class Squares {
+
+  /**
+   * Cache tag used to forget every memoized square.
+   */
+  public const CACHE_TAG = 'bench_memo';
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a Squares service.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheBackendInterface $cache
+   *   The request-scoped memory cache bin.
+   */
+  public function __construct(
+    protected CacheBackendInterface $cache,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Returns $n squared, memoized for the rest of the current request.
+   *
+   * @param int|float $n
+   *   The number to square.
+   *
+   * @return int|float
+   *   The square of $n.
+   */
+  public function square(int|float $n): int|float {
+    $cid = 'bench_memo:square:' . $n;
+    if ($cached = $this->cache->get($cid)) {
+      return $cached->data;
+    }
+
+    // Pretend this is expensive.
+    $result = $n * $n;
+    $this->cache->set($cid, $result, CacheBackendInterface::CACHE_PERMANENT, [self::CACHE_TAG]);
+    return $result;
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_finder;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface;
+use Drupal\user\UserInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Finds user accounts by their properties.
+ */
+class Users {
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a Users object.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager
+   *   The entity type manager.
+   */
+  public function __construct(
+    protected EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Loads the user account with the given email address.
+   *
+   * @param string $mail
+   *   The email address.
+   *
+   * @return \Drupal\user\UserInterface|null
+   *   The user account, or NULL if there is none.
+   */
+  public function byMail(string $mail): ?UserInterface {
+    return $this->loadSingle(['mail' => $mail]);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Loads the user account with the given user name.
+   *
+   * @param string $name
+   *   The user name.
+   *
+   * @return \Drupal\user\UserInterface|null
+   *   The user account, or NULL if there is none.
+   */
+  public function byName(string $name): ?UserInterface {
+    return $this->loadSingle(['name' => $name]);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Loads the first user matching the given properties.
+   *
+   * @param array $properties
+   *   The properties to match.
+   *
+   * @return \Drupal\user\UserInterface|null
+   *   The user account, or NULL if there is none.
+   */
+  protected function loadSingle(array $properties): ?UserInterface {
+    $users = $this->entityTypeManager->getStorage('user')->loadByProperties($properties);
+    $user = reset($users);
+    return $user instanceof UserInterface ? $user : NULL;
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_tx;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Database\Connection;
+
+/**
+ * Writes pairs of key_value rows atomically.
+ */
+class TxWriter {
+
+  /**
+   * The key_value collection used by this writer.
+   */
+  const COLLECTION = 'bench_tx';
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a TxWriter object.
+   *
+   * @param \Drupal\Core\Database\Connection $database
+   *   The database connection.
+   */
+  public function __construct(protected Connection $database) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Stores two values in key_value as one atomic unit.
+   *
+   * Either both rows are saved or neither is. The transaction is committed
+   * before this method returns.
+   *
+   * @param mixed $a
+   *   The value stored under the name "a".
+   * @param mixed $b
+   *   The value stored under the name "b".
+   *
+   * @throws \Throwable
+   *   Rethrows any failure after rolling back the transaction.
+   */
+  public function writePair(mixed $a, mixed $b): void {
+    $values = ['a' => serialize($a), 'b' => serialize($b)];
+    $transaction = $this->database->startTransaction();
+    try {
+      foreach ($values as $name => $value) {
+        $this->database->merge('key_value')
+          ->keys(['collection' => self::COLLECTION, 'name' => $name])
+          ->fields(['value' => $value])
+          ->execute();
+      }
+    }
+    catch (\Throwable $e) {
+      $transaction->rollBack();
+      throw $e;
+    }
+    // Drop the transaction object so it commits now, not at end of scope.
+    unset($transaction);
+  }
+
+}

+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_tx;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Database\Connection;
+
+/**
+ * Writes pairs of values to the key_value table atomically.
+ */
+class Writer {
+
+  const COLLECTION = 'bench_tx';
+
+  public function __construct(
+    protected readonly Connection $connection,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Stores $a and $b as two key_value rows, both or neither.
+   *
+   * @throws \Exception
+   *   Rethrown if either insert fails; the transaction is rolled back first.
+   */
+  public function writePair(mixed $a, mixed $b): void {
+    $transaction = $this->connection->startTransaction();
+    try {
+      $this->insertRow('a', $a);
+      $this->insertRow('b', $b);
+      $transaction->commitOrRelease();
+    }
+    catch (\Exception $e) {
+      // One of the INSERTs failed, roll back the whole pair and rethrow.
+      $transaction->rollBack();
+      throw $e;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Inserts a single key_value row in the bench_tx collection.
+   */
+  protected function insertRow(string $name, mixed $value): void {
+    $this->connection->insert('key_value')
+      ->fields([
+        'collection' => self::COLLECTION,
+        'name' => $name,
+        'value' => serialize($value),
+      ])
+      ->execute();
+  }
+
+}

+function bench_wordcount_preprocess_node(array &$variables): void {
+  if ($variables['view_mode'] !== 'full') {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  $node = $variables['node'];
+  if ($node instanceof NodeInterface) {
+    $title = trim((string) $node->label());
+    $words = $title === '' ? [] : preg_split('/\s+/u', $title);
+    $variables['attributes']['data-words'] = count($words);
+  }
+}
